title: Native post-DoAction event wake on Chromium renderer AT-SPI and GTK3 foreground, with event-fidelity controls

knob.name: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_WAKE=event (default off; read once per process)
knob.behaviour: In perform_action_ref, an AT-SPI event stream is opened BEFORE DoAction; after the DoAction reply the fixed sleep is replaced by a wait for the first object:state-changed (not defunct), object:text-changed or object:property-change whose sender bus name AND object path equal the acted object, bounded by the sleep deadline (50 ms). A closed stream sleeps to the deadline. Phase marks: post_wake_open <bus> <path>; post_wake_event <kind> | post_wake_deadline | post_wake_stream_closed.
knob.claims: none: the return value and receipt are unchanged; the event is a wake hint only; every verdict comes from the target-owned oracle

step0_pilot_facts.class: REAL (pilot, not measured; raw kept in the packet under raw/pilots/)
step0_pilot_facts.T1_exposure: With --force-renderer-accessibility and org.a11y.Status IsEnabled=true on the private session bus, Chrome 151.0.7922.71 exposes the page through AT-SPI: check box 'I agree' [check], entry 'Note', push button 'Save note' (pilot1/pilot2). STEP 0 gate: T1 APPLICABLE.
step0_pilot_facts.T1_text_set_value: set_value on the Chromium entry is refused in background: code set_value_unavailable, effect none, 'cached element exposes neither EditableText nor Value' (pilot2). The AT-SPI set_value path of the T1 text task is NOT_APPLICABLE.
step0_pilot_facts.foreground_X11: With delivery_mode foreground on X11, element clicks on Chrome and on the GTK3 fixture take route global_input (XTest after window activation); no atspi_action do_action_replied mark: the post-DoAction sleep is not on the executed path (pilot1-3). Source: impl_.rs foreground_element_click.
step0_pilot_facts.T1_background_route: Background element clicks on Chrome take route accessibility (perform_action_ref DoAction), inside the focus guard (220 ms settle watch after the body).
step0_pilot_facts.chromium_events: DoAction on the native checkbox moves focus to it: the acted object emits state-changed:focused then state-changed:checked; on the button, state-changed:focused only (pilot3 listener).

targets.T1: system Chrome (version recorded per block), harness-launched, fresh --user-data-dir under the lane tmp dir, --force-renderer-accessibility, session a11y IsEnabled=true on the PRIVATE bus; owned page served by fixture_server.py whose journal/state file is the oracle; background delivery (the only X11 delivery whose element click reaches DoAction).
targets.T2: canonical GTK3 fixture libs/cua-driver/tests/fixtures/apps/linux/gtk3/main.py, checkbox and text, delivery_mode foreground on every action; actual route recorded from receipts.
targets.T3: WebKitGTK MiniBrowser: NOT_RUN. No WebKitGTK host package is installed (pacman -Qs webkit: none); the only MiniBrowser binaries are inside a flatpak GNOME 50 runtime, which is not a host install and would add the flatpak sandbox and its D-Bus/a11y proxies to the environment. No system packages are installed (rule).

tasks.T1/checkbox: get_window_state -> scripted lookup 'I agree' -> click(element_token, background). Oracle: agreed flips, seq+1.
tasks.T1/submit: DEVIATION (replaces T1 text, whose set_value path is NOT_APPLICABLE): the page pre-fills Note with a per-trial token from the URL; get_window_state -> lookup 'Save note' -> click(element_token, background). Oracle: note_saved == token, seq+1.
tasks.T2/text: as N-01R, set_value(Note, token, foreground) then click(Save note, foreground).
tasks.scripted_chooser: jev-use NativeObservation + eligible_controls exact unique label match (N-01R). For T1 only, jev-use rule 5 (in_web_content -> browser source) is waived because T1 deliberately acts on web content through the native AT-SPI tools; rules 1-4 and the token requirement still apply.

families.M: T1, background, arms B / S0 (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS=0) / EW (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_WAKE=event); primary for T1
families.F: T1, background, arms B_F0 / S0_F0 / EW_F0 = the same with CUA_DRIVER_EXP_FOCUS_GUARD_SETTLE_MS=0; SUPPLEMENTARY: isolates the post-DoAction wait as the only post-action wait (the shape of the unguarded AT-SPI action routes: X11 ax_fg for non-showing elements, Hyprland foreground semantic clicks; those routes themselves are not measured or claimed). The settle watch stays IRREDUCIBLE per N-01R; F is diagnostic only.
families.G: T2, foreground, arms B / S0 / EW; primary for T2

design: n = 20 per arm per task; 20 rounds; per round both tasks (first alternates), per task the 3 arms in Williams row (round mod 6) over all 6 orders; one fresh Driver and one fresh target (Chrome + server, or GTK3 fixture) per trial; phase trace on; loadavg per trial; every trial kept. Blocks: plan.json (make_plan.py), every block under bin/quiet-timed, each well under 15 minutes.

measures.effect_visible_at_return: the first oracle sample that STARTS at or after the last action's tool return shows the expected state
measures.T_oracle: first observation send -> read-end of the first oracle sample at/after return that shows the expected state (2 ms sampler)
measures.T_land: first oracle sample showing the expected state, regardless of return
measures.effect_after_reply: T1: page journal arrival (server wall clock) of the effect - do_action_replied (Driver wall clock); same host clock
measures.event_latency: EW with wake=event: wake mark (wall) - page journal arrival of the effect (wall). Negative = the event reached the Driver before the page's own report reached the oracle

statistics: medians, nearest-rank p95; paired within-round differences T_B - T_X (B = the family base arm); percentile bootstrap over rounds, 10000 resamples, seed 909; S = median T_B / median T_X with the same bootstrap

hypotheses.H1: sleep need: on T1, S0 has the effect NOT visible at tool return in >= 10% of trials (>= 2/20 per task). Evaluated in M (primary, as specified) and in F (supplementary, S0_F0).
hypotheses.H2: event wake: EW keeps B's correctness (verified and visible-at-return counts equal to B's) and the CI of median(T_B - T_EW) excludes 0 with the point estimate > 0. Evaluated per task in M (primary) and F (supplementary, EW_F0 vs B_F0).
hypotheses.H3: GTK3 foreground: S0 has the effect visible at return 20/20 per task. Pre-registered expectation from STEP 0: the X11 foreground click never reaches DoAction, so the knobs do not touch the executed path; H3 is then vacuous and is recorded with the actual route.

controls.arm: EW, T1, background, n = 10 each; an independent AT-SPI listener (atspi_listener.py, copied verbatim from OWN-20) records every bus signal for (a), (b), (c), (d)
controls.a_replace: page variant replace: ARIA checkbox (not focusable); 10 ms after the click the page replaces it with a NEW node of the same label, checks the new node 15 ms later and reports. PASS: 0 trials where EW woke on an event not from the acted object path (false_wake = wake=event without an acted-path wake-set event on the listener at or before wake + 5 ms); oracle verified 10/10.
controls.b_decoy: page variant decoy: acted ARIA checkbox (not focusable) changes its own state 30 ms after the click; an in-page decoy ARIA checkbox toggles every 4 ms and a separate GTK3 decoy app toggles every 5 ms. PASS: false-wake rate 0/10 (otherwise reported); listener shows foreign wake-set events inside the wait in >= 8/10 trials (discriminating); oracle verified 10/10.
controls.c_reconnect: page variant reconnect: as decoy without decoys; on the page's click report the harness SIGTERMs this session's at-spi2-registryd (pid from the private bus) and starts a new one. PASS: wait never exceeds the deadline + 5 ms; the click call completes without error; receipt effect stays unverifiable (no success claimed); every wake=event is backed by an acted-path event on the listener; oracle verified 10/10. Recorded: whether events still arrive after the restart.
controls.c2_busdrop: SUPPLEMENTARY, one trial per session: on the page's click report the harness SIGTERMs this session's private AT-SPI bus broker. PASS: wake reason stream_closed or deadline in 10/10 and wait >= 45 ms (fallback to the deadline), the click completes without error, receipt unverifiable, oracle verified 10/10.
controls.d_noop: page variant noop: role=button 'Do nothing' with no handler. PASS: wake reason deadline 10/10 with wait >= 45 ms; oracle shows no change (seq unchanged) 10/10; receipt claims nothing beyond unverifiable / suspected_noop.
controls.smoke: default-off: W with no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* knob, T1 checkbox B, n = 5: no exp_knob marks, wait 50-53 ms, 5/5 verified.

gates: per arm: valid route (T1: click route accessibility, delivery background, do_action_replied + post_sleep_done marks, exp_knob marks exactly the arm's knobs, EW: post_wake_open + a wake-end mark; T2: click route global_input, delivery foreground, knob marks exactly the arm's) AND oracle verified in >= 95% (>= 19/20); 0 stale dispatches, 0 duplicate mutations (final seq exactly expected), 0 unverified successes (T always ends on the oracle; receipts are never the oracle); the success oracle is never the event.

disposition_rules.KEEP (per target): H2 holds with correctness equal to B and all required controls (a, b, c, d) pass
disposition_rules.KILL scoped to a target: S0 already safe there (H1 false: effect visible at return in S0 >= 19/20 per task with correctness equal to B), so no wait is needed and the sleep-deletion scope extends; OR EW no better than B (H2 CI includes 0)
disposition_rules.REVISE: correctness holds only with named qualifications
disposition_rules.primary: T1 disposition from family M; T2 from family G. Family F and control c2 feed only the statement on whether any native wait remains that is worth an event wake.
disposition_rules.inputs_cited_not_remeasured: N-01R (exp/n-01r-native-wait-ab-20261002 @ 3bb4a7fc7): settle watch IRREDUCIBLE, sleep DELETED on GTK3 background; OWN-20 (exp/own-20-atspi-invalidation-census-20261002 @ 6da15bf35): event absence authorizes nothing

claim_boundary: Linux X11 Xvfb (private session), Chrome version recorded per block, GTK3 canonical fixture, binary W (sha256 above). No Hyprland, native-Wayland, WebKitGTK, Electron or real-seat row is claimed.
invariants: no new service; knob env-gated and default-off; event = wake hint, never the oracle; event absence authorizes nothing; no authority from passive state; provider 0 requests
